column1:
Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Negombo
to Batticaloa via Colombo, Galle, Hambanthota and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers may occur at
few places in the other sea areas during the evening or night.

Winds will be South-westerly or Variable. Wind speed will be (25-35) kmph.
Wind speed can increase up to 50 kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending Colombo to
Pottuvil via Galle, Matara and Hambantota.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Pottuvil via Galle, Matara and Hambantota will
be fairly rough at times.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
